0.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_000
0.description: Perhaps you're wondering what all of these decorations are for? Why, it's that time of year again, and the Moonfire Faire has returned right here to Costa del Sol! If you have any questions, I'd be more than happy to help.

1.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_010
1.description: Perhaps you're wondering what all of these decorations are for? Why, it's the Moonfire Faire, of course! If you have any questions, I'd be more than happy to help.

4.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_A1_000_002
4.description: What is the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course?

5.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_A1_000_003
5.description: How do I take part in the course?

7.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_A1_000_005
7.description: What is the Iron Culinarian Challenge?

10.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_020
10.description: Several years ago, the Adventurers' Guild formed the Cascadiers to combat an invasion of rampaging Bombards. The Moonfire Faire was first held to attract new members to the cause.

11.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_021
11.description: It proved so popular that it has been held annually ever since, whether the Bombards appear or not. It helps spread word of the guild's activities and generate interest among potential new recruits. In charge of the proceedings is the grand chaperone, Haermaga.

12.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_022
12.description: He has decided to have members of the Adventurers' Guild demonstrate their courage and physical prowess to faire-goers through a series of challenges in Costa del Sol.

13.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_030
13.description: Master Gegeruju has once again provided the space and funding for the event. It's sure to be the most spectacular Moonfire Faire held to date!

14.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_031
14.description: Since you're here, why not join in the festivities?

15.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_032
15.description: The event is being held as we speak, courtesy of the ever-generous Master Gegeruju. Your participation would be most appreciated!

16.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_040
16.description: The Eorzean Nimble Warrior course offers adventurers unparalleled challenge and excitement!

17.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_041
17.description: Built under the supervision of Haermaga and with the financial backing of Master Gegeruju, this three-part obstacle course tests the physical limits of those brave enough to face it.

18.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_042
18.description: To succeed, challengers will need endurance, dexterity, and nerves of steel─qualities required of an adventurer when exploring monster-infested catacombs and the like. Only in this case, there's no chance of them being horribly killed! Well, almost none.

19.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_043
19.description: Naturally, a spectacular prize of no less than <hex:021A020203>four<hex:021A020103> Faire vouchers awaits those who overcome this seemingly insurmountable trial. So? Has your interest been piqued?

20.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_050
20.description: To test your skills in the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, you need only register with our chaperone, conveniently stationed near the starting point.

21.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_051
21.description: Don't forget to speak to her beforehand, otherwise you won't be able to claim the prize for reaching the end!

22.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_052
22.description: In fact, you can complete the course and collect the reward as many times as you like. Just be sure to let the chaperone know before starting again from the beginning.

23.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_060
23.description: The rules are simple. First, make your way to the checkpoint midway through, and report to the chaperone stationed there. She is there to ensure that all challengers make their way through the course fair and square.

24.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_061
24.description: From there, proceed to the goal and present yourself to P'obyano to claim your prize.

25.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_062
25.description: It may seem tricky at first, but there's no need to rush. There is no time limit, and the prize is the same regardless of how long it takes you to reach the end.

26.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_063
26.description: Don't worry if you take a plunge─simply return to the beginning of that section and try again! You can do this as many times as necessary.

27.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_064
27.description: There's a lot more I could tell you about the course, but there really is no substitute for experiencing it for yourself, from the thrills to the spills. Do go out there and give it a try!

28.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_070
28.description: Fancy yourself a skilled hand with a skillet? Able to work miracles with a mixing bowl? Then the Iron Culinarian Contest is for you!

29.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_071
29.description: We're looking to show off the surpassing cooking skills of adventurers from across the realm by having them serve up servings of scrumptious battered fish, and rewarding them richly for their efforts!

30.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_072
30.description: If you wish to take part, the process is simple enough: simply speak to Hildelana, buy yourself a fresh-caught haddock from the friendly fisherman standing by her, and get cooking!

31.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_073
31.description: If your dish is deemed suitable to serve to the masses, we'll reward you with a Faire voucher redeemable for all sorts of spectacular rewards! Doesn't that sound wonderful?

32.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_080
32.description: Are you the type of person who runs off to your favorite fishing hole as soon as you have a moment's respite? Then you won't want to miss the Moonfire Faire's Angling Extravaganza!

33.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_081
33.description: Our goal with this delightful event is to show off the admirable angling skills of adventurers like you, whilst also securing the necessary ingredients for the delicious battered fish that is always popular amongst our faire-goers.

34.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_082
34.description: The rules are simple enough. First, you'll want to locate and speak with my associate J'nangho. She'll tell you just what sort of fish she's looking for─I'll give you a hint: it's haddock!─and just how many she requires. It's three, by the way.

35.name: TEXT_FESSUM2019_00624_ETHELIA_000_083
35.description: Lure in precisely what she requested and bring it back to her, and you'll earn a Faire voucher for your efforts! As you surely know Faire vouchers can be redeemed for any number of enticing rewards. A mutually beneficial arrangement, I'm sure you'll agree. So what are you waiting for?
